tasks.subject: Task 1: Central config with flags
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add config.Config holding all paths/worker count, overridable by flags, replacing 3 duplicated textOutputPath vars.

**Files:**
- config/config.go
- config/config_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Default() returns current hard-coded values and Workers==5
- [ ] Parse overrides only the given flags
- [ ] Parse errors on -workers 0 and unknown flags without exiting

**Verify:** `go test ./config/ -v -> all PASS`

Full steps and code: see Task 1 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md

tasks.subject: Task 2: Schema parser
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure schema.Parse(io.Reader) that flushes the final table at EOF (bug #1); table count is len(tables).

**Files:**
- schema/schema.go
- schema/schema_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Last table without trailing blank line is returned
- [ ] '-' lines ignored, blank line ends a table, 'Disc' header heuristic unchanged
- [ ] Whitespace-only lines skipped without panic; header with no columns yields no table

**Verify:** `go test ./schema/ -v -> all PASS`

Full steps and code: see Task 2 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md

```json:metadata
{"files": ["schema/schema.go", "schema/schema_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./schema/ -v -> all PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Last table without trailing blank line is returned", "'-' lines ignored, blank line ends a table, 'Disc' header heuristic unchanged", "Whitespace-only lines skipped without panic; header with no columns yields no table"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: CSV converter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** csv.Convert(name,textDir,csvDir) closes handles, has no line limit, surfaces flush errors, uses precomputed filter and non-regex digit check (bugs #4,#5,#6 + efficiency).

**Files:**
- csv/csvwriter.go
- csv/csvwriter_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] part_number and colloquial_name filters keep current semantics; Stats correct; blank lines not counted
- [ ] 200KB field converts without error; CRLF handled
- [ ] Missing input returns error, no CSV; partial CSV removed on failure; csv dir auto-created

**Verify:** `go test ./csv/ -v -race -> all PASS`

Full steps and code: see Task 3 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md

```json:metadata
{"files": ["csv/csvwriter.go", "csv/csvwriter_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./csv/ -v -race -> all PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["part_number and colloquial_name filters keep current semantics; Stats correct; blank lines not counted", "200KB field converts without error; CRLF handled", "Missing input returns error, no CSV; partial CSV removed on failure; csv dir auto-created"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Worker pool and Decomp processor
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generic Run pool with exactly N workers and no WaitGroup race, plus NewProcessor that runs Decomp then converts that table's file (bugs #8,#9, overlap).

**Files:**
- querylist/querylist.go
- querylist/querylist_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Run uses exactly `workers` goroutines, processes each table once, calls onResult from one goroutine
- [ ] go test -race clean
- [ ] FileBase strips 2-char prefix, lowercases, errors on names <3 chars
- [ ] Conversion skipped when Decomp fails; Decomp output captured in error; Elapsed populated

**Verify:** `go test ./querylist/ -v -race -> all PASS`

Full steps and code: see Task 4 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md

```json:metadata
{"files": ["querylist/querylist.go", "querylist/querylist_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./querylist/ -v -race -> all PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Run uses exactly `workers` goroutines, processes each table once, calls onResult from one goroutine", "go test -race clean", "FileBase strips 2-char prefix, lowercases, errors on names <3 chars", "Conversion skipped when Decomp fails; Decomp output captured in error; Elapsed populated"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: main wiring and output
tasks.description:
**Goal:** main parses flags, handles schema open errors (bug #2), runs pool, prints per-table lines and summary from one goroutine, exits non-zero on failure.

**Files:**
- main.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Missing schema -> stderr error, exit 1, text dir untouched
- [ ] Zero tables -> exit 1; prints 'Tables found: N' == len(tables)
- [ ] Per-table [i/N] ok/FAIL lines and 'Done: X ok, Y failed in <elapsed>'; exit 1 if any failed
- [ ] Text dir created before Decomp runs

**Verify:** `go build ./... && go vet ./... && GOOS=windows go build -o /dev/null ./... && go test ./... -race -> exit 0`

Full steps and code: see Task 5 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md

tasks.subject: Task 6: End-to-end smoke test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the pipeline end to end with a fake Decomp script on macOS, including last-table, failure and bad-schema paths.

**Files:**
- scripts/fake-decomp.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 3-table schema without trailing blank line -> Tables found: 3 and 3 ok lines
- [ ] part_number.csv has only digit NIINs; colloquial_name.csv has no empty names
- [ ] Failing table prints FAIL, is listed in summary, produces no CSV even with stale txt, exit code 1
- [ ] Nonexistent -schema -> exit 1 and nothing created

**Verify:** `Run Steps 2-5 of Task 6 in the plan; outputs match the Acceptance Criteria`

Full steps and code: see Task 6 in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-29-fl-parse-improvements.md
